answers.genPolicy:e17c46ea8610618236e5b651dfaedf:
[B1] < UserX | ... > < cloudB | 'buffer' : nils , UserX : ('permission' : true , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'publishToggle' cloudB
=> < UserX | ... > < cloudB | 'buffer' : 'toggle' , UserX : ('permission' : true , ...) , ... > $ cloudB 'acknowledge' UserX .
[B2] < cloudB | UserX : ('permission' : true , ...) , ... > $ cloudB 'revokePermission' cloudB | (UserX)
=> < cloudB | UserX : ('permission' : false , ...) , ... > .
[B3] < UserX | ... > < cloudB | 'buffer' : Message , deviceA : ('permission' : true , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'releaseMessage' cloudB
=> < UserX | ... > < cloudB | 'buffer' : nils , deviceA : ('permission' : true , ...) , ... > $ cloudB 'publish' deviceA | (Message) .
[B3] < deviceA | 'power' : false , ... > $ cloudB 'publish' deviceA | ('toggle')
=> < deviceA | 'power' : true , ... > .
[B3] < deviceA | 'power' : true , ... > $ cloudB 'publish' deviceA | ('toggle')
=> < deviceA | 'power' : true , ... > .
